about: World audio for Tiny Consequences (S21, docs/v3/80_WORLD_AUDIO.md). Generated by scripts/gen_audio.mjs with the ElevenLabs sound effects model; each entry is a prompt, a length, whether it loops seamlessly, how many takes to keep (variants), and its mixer group. Only sounds of things the world has.
